Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
When comparing solid options like our MOISSANITE Gothic Cross Cutout Pendant - 925 Silver - 3 Sizes 1.33"-3" (starting at $77) and the MOISSANITE Royalty Jesus Piece Fully Iced Out Pendant - 925 Silver - 3 Sizes 1.5"-3" (starting at $172), the price difference reflects complexity and stone weight.
The cheaper option gives you solid 925 sterling silver and hand-set VVS moissanite stones for max shine at an entry price point—plenty for daily wear. The pricier piece uses rare, harder-to-cut baguette and square moissanite stones with a much higher carat weight, making it a heavier statement piece.
If you just want great shine and durability on a budget, the cheaper one is perfectly fine. The extra cost for the pricier option is only worth it if you specifically want complex stone cuts and heavy carat weight.
